d: Protests continue in Pakistan-Occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK) as the Joint Awami Action Committe or JAAC, calls for free and fair assembly elections. As per reports, Pakistan's army has shot at several peaceful protesters, killing at least 40 on Monday and Tuesday and wounding nearly a 100. Meanwhile, Canada is tightening its immigration system, and Indians are feeling the biggest impact. Permanent residency approvals from India have fallen sharply, while international students face tougher rules, stricter work regulations, and growing uncertainty over post-graduation work permits.
